visual.general_description: PRISMA-style flow chart with printed counts for a literature review.
visual.detailed_description: Black-and-white flow chart with four vertical stage labels on the left (Identification, Screening, Eligibility, Included) and boxes with printed text. Left column boxes read: Records identified through Pubmed and Google scholar searching from January 1968 to April 2022 (n = 753); Records screened after duplicates removal (n = 602); Full-text articles assessed for eligibility (n = 152); Articles included in qualitative synthesis (n = 51) and Total of detailed cases (n = 52). Right column boxes read: Duplicate records removed (n = 151); Full-text articles excluded due to unrelated topics (n = 450); Full-text articles excluded due to the absence of information regarding demographic, clinical or therapeutic characteristics (n = 101). Downward arrows connect the left column boxes and short horizontal arrows lead from the vertical connector to each right column box.
